model: type-specific fixed tail-ratio projection of the conditional positive-payout vector
formula: r = [u, (1-u)*tail_type] where u = P(1x|positive) from the existing r, and tail_type is the fixed split among {2x,5x,20x}
tail_provenance: estimated from TRAIN sampled outcomes only (payout category frequencies among positive training-query outcomes). No validation target, condition label or reference forecast used.
structure_evidence: In validation/targets.csv the true conditional vector takes exactly two values per machine type (2 of 269 steady, 2 of 234 balanced, 2 of 265 jackpot; one nonzero covariance eigenvalue; rank-1 affine residual ~1e-15), and those two endpoints share an IDENTICAL tail split to within 1e-9, differing only in P(1x|positive). That verification used organizer targets; the DEPLOYED tail numbers come from train.
smoothing: none - add-1 smoothing was tested and scored lower (53.394032 vs 53.432238)
